reason: I'd probably take the free 30-minute call and the 15 companies, since that costs me nothing, but after two big customers cut orders I'm not putting EUR 1,500 down this month on another outside firm. The last one I paid gave me slides and no pipeline.
objection: Your proof is a logistics company. would_change_my_mind: Talking to a past SaaS or IT services client who actually closed deals in DACH from these meetings, plus a 15-company sample with names I don't already know and would really want to meet.
